title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Commercial Account Tier Note — Month Share of the Late Payment Charge
content:
The late payment charge on a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account is a monthly charge. A statement that shows fewer than 30 days past due is charged only a share of the month, set by its days past due and by the account's tier.

## Month share

| Days past due on the statement | Tier | Late charge month share |
|---|---|---|
| Fewer than 30 | Commercial Account Net 45 or Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | Prorated: the days counted for the late charge divided by 30 |
| Fewer than 30 | Any other tier (Commercial Account Net 30 or Net 30 Select) | The half-month share, 0.5 |
| 30 or more | Any | One full month, 1 |

The days past due are those shown on the latest closed statement. The tier is the account's own tier.

## How the share acts

The monthly charge — the late charge base times the monthly percentage the charge is computed at, divided by one hundred — is multiplied by the late charge month share. The share is not rounded; the product is then rounded to the nearest cent once, and it is never less than the tier's minimum late payment charge when the late charge base is above zero.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, late charge base 6000.00 at 1.50 percent, monthly charge 90.00)

| Tier | Days past due | Days counted for the late charge | Share | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Net 45 | 12 | 12 | 12 divided by 30, 0.4 | 36.00 |
| Net 60 Enterprise | 29 | 29 | 29 divided by 30 | 87.00 |
| Net 45 | 30 | not used | 1 | 90.00 |
| Net 30 Select (at 1.75 percent, monthly 105.00) | 12 | not used | 0.5 | 52.50 |
